question: pickup zone stats struct with top 3 dropoff zones list json
sql: WITH zone_drop AS (SELECT PULocationID AS pu, DOLocationID AS do, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM nyc_taxi_trips GROUP BY 1,2), ranked AS (SELECT pu, do, cnt, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pu ORDER BY cnt DESC, do) AS rn FROM zone_drop), top_drops AS (SELECT pu, LIST(STRUCT_PACK(zone := do, trips := cnt) ORDER BY rn) AS drops FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY pu), stats AS (SELECT PULocationID AS pu, COUNT(*) AS trips, AVG(fare_amount) AS avg_fare FROM nyc_taxi_trips GROUP BY 1) SELECT TO_JSON(STRUCT_PACK(pickup_zone := s.pu, trips := s.trips, avg_fare := ROUND(s.avg_fare, 2), top_dropoffs := t.drops)) AS zone_json FROM stats s JOIN top_drops t USING (pu) ORDER BY s.trips DESC LIMIT 10

question: vendor payment type breakdown list of structs
sql: WITH vp AS (SELECT VendorID, payment_type, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT VendorID, LIST(STRUCT_PACK(payment_type := payment_type, trips := trips) ORDER BY trips DESC) AS payment_breakdown FROM vp GROUP BY VendorID ORDER BY VendorID

question: hourly top 5 pickup zones ranked list
sql: WITH hp AS (SELECT EXTRACT(hour FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hr, PULocationID AS zone, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips GROUP BY 1,2), ranked AS (SELECT hr, zone, trips, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY hr ORDER BY trips DESC, zone) AS rn FROM hp) SELECT hr, LIST(STRUCT_PACK(rank := rn, zone := zone, trips := trips) ORDER BY rn) AS top_zones FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5 GROUP BY hr ORDER BY hr

question: trips to top 10 pickup zones list_contains filter
sql: WITH top_zones AS (SELECT LIST(PULocationID) AS zones FROM (SELECT PULocationID, COUNT(*) AS c FROM nyc_taxi_trips GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY c DESC LIMIT 10)) SELECT COUNT(*) AS trips, COUNT(DISTINCT DOLocationID) AS distinct_dropoffs FROM nyc_taxi_trips, top_zones WHERE LIST_CONTAINS(zones, DOLocationID)

question: vendor nested json stats top 3 ratecodes list
sql: WITH vr AS (SELECT VendorID, RatecodeID, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips GROUP BY 1,2), ranked AS (SELECT VendorID, RatecodeID, trips, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY VendorID ORDER BY trips DESC, RatecodeID) AS rn FROM vr), top_rates AS (SELECT VendorID, LIST(STRUCT_PACK(ratecode := RatecodeID, trips := trips) ORDER BY rn) AS rates FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 3 GROUP BY VendorID), stats AS (SELECT VendorID, COUNT(*) AS trips, AVG(trip_distance) AS avg_dist FROM nyc_taxi_trips GROUP BY 1) SELECT TO_JSON(STRUCT_PACK(vendor := s.VendorID, trips := s.trips, avg_distance := ROUND(s.avg_dist, 2), top_ratecodes := t.rates)) AS vendor_json FROM stats s JOIN top_rates t USING (VendorID) ORDER BY s.VendorID

question: all zones unnest zero fill trip counts
sql: WITH zones AS (SELECT UNNEST(RANGE(1, 266)) AS zone_id), counts AS (SELECT PULocationID AS zone_id, COUNT(*) AS trips FROM nyc_taxi_trips GROUP BY 1) SELECT z.zone_id, COALESCE(c.trips, 0) AS trips FROM zones z LEFT JOIN counts c USING (zone_id) ORDER BY z.zone_id
